name: Web no Naka no Kanojo ~Password ni Himerareta Nazo~
original_name: Webの中の彼女 ～パスワードに秘められた謎～
source:
Main character is a university student. He uses internet just for nanpa (meeting women,) but once got interested in the ruined village sinking into the dam by accident. Strange things start to happen around the hero - first he starts to receive intimidation letters, then his informant suddenly dies...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名大学生。他上网只是为了搭讪，却偶然对一座正沉入水坝的废弃村庄产生了兴趣。奇怪的事情开始在主角身边接连发生：先是收到恐吓信，随后提供情报的人突然死亡……

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
